text:
jess: Tiny off-hours challenge — pick exactly ONE song and ONE short story that make a perfect bedside pair. No lists, just one of each. I’ll kick it off: 'Night Drive' (lo-fi remix) + 'The Lottery' by Shirley Jackson. Your turn!
omar: Love this. 'Blue Train' (Coltrane) + 'The Dead' by James Joyce. slow burn but stunning. :headphones:
kai: Haha classic kai quiet flex — mine: 'Bloodbuzz Ohio' (Bon Iver) + 'Cathedral' by Raymond Carver. simple, a bit raw.
maria: @kai that combo is chef's kiss. I'll go with something lighter — 'Heroes' (David Bowie) + 'A Good Man Is Hard to Find' by Flannery O'Connor for weird comfort. :popcorn:
samir: Ooh tough. I'm throwing in 'Ocean Eyes' (Billie Eilish) + 'The Tell-Tale Heart' by Poe. bedtime paranoia vibe. :grimacing:
anya: quick one: 'Claire de Lune' (Debussy instrumental) + 'The Paper Menagerie' by Ken Liu. soothing > tears.
meme-bot: Daily reminder: reading in bed not actually sleep-friendly. :zzz: Reaction :thumbsup: from 3 people.
jess: These are great. two meta-asks: 1) if you voted for someone else's pairing, reply with "+1" and which pairing. 2) if you want to swap the music for something instrumental, say so.
omar: +1 to @kai (Bloodbuzz + Carver)
kai: thanks @omar! also happy if someone swaps in an instrumental — Carver loves quiet.
maria: +1 @jess (Night Drive + The Lottery) — brilliant contrast.
samir: swap: instrumental piano instead of Ocean Eyes pls.
anya: +1 @maria (Heroes + O'Connor)
jess: tally so far: @kai 1, @jess 1, @maria 1, @samir 0 (but wants swap), @anya 1. still lots of contenders though.
meme-bot: Poll mode: sadly I only support binary choices. :robot_face:
omar: This thread is perfect midweek hygge. can we make a tiny shared doc with all pairings for future sad evenings?
jess: yes — I'll paste in a tiny note later. for now: last call for picks!
kai: final: 'Bloodbuzz Ohio' + 'Cathedral' stays. goodnight y'all. :crescent_moon:
jess: night! thanks for playing. next week: one-song-one-short-story sequel? :thinking_face:
